claims.source_quote_ar: انسلخ الشهر، كقولك انجرد الشهر، وسنة جرداء.
claims.claim_ar: استعارة في لفظ «انسلخ» حيث استُعمل فعل نزوع الجلد للدلالة على زوال الأشهر؛ تشبيه بلاغي مجازي لعَدم البقاء السابق.
claims.claim_en: A metaphor (isti'ara) in the verb 'انسلخ' — using the literal verb of skin-shedding to signify the departure/ending of the month; a figurative expression likening the month's end to shedding.
claims.rhetorical_effect: Gives a vivid, concrete image of the month's ending, increasing immediacy and perceptual clarity.

claims.source_quote_ar: فَاقْتُلُوا الْمُشْرِكِينَ يعنى الذين نقضوكم وظاهروا عليكم حَيْثُ وَجَدْتُمُوهُمْ من حلّ أو حرم وَخُذُوهُمْ وأسروهم.
claims.claim_ar: تكرار الأفعال الأمرية المتعاقبة (فاقْتُلُوا... وَخُذُوهُمْ... وَاحْصُرُوهُمْ...) لتكثيف التأكيد على الإجراءات العملية المتتابعة ضد المخالفين.
claims.claim_en: Repetition (takrar) of successive imperatives (e.g., 'kill... take them... besiege them...') to intensify and stress the sequence of concrete measures to be taken.
claims.needs_review_reason: Sequence of coordinated imperatives could also be read as gradation or muqabalah; verify classification as pure 'takrar' versus other badiʿ subtypes.
claims.rhetorical_effect: Creates a forceful, marching rhythm of commands that emphasizes resolve and concrete action.

claims.source_quote_ar: فَخَلُّوا سَبِيلَهُمْ فأطلقوا عنهم بعد الأسر والحصر. أو فكفوا عنهم ولا تتعرّضوا لهم
claims.claim_ar: التفات بلاغي من أمر القتل والأسر إلى أمر الإطلاق والصفح عند شروط التوبة — تغييرٌ في النبرة والغاية الخطابية (التدرج في الحكم والتخفيف عند تحقق التوبة).
claims.claim_en: Iltifat (a rhetorical shift) from commands of fighting/containment to the command to release/leave them if they repent — a change in tone and legal consequence, marking conditional mitigation.
claims.rhetorical_effect: Softens earlier harsh directives by introducing conditional mercy, highlighting moral and legal nuance.

claims.source_quote_ar: حصرهم أن يحال بينهم وبين المسجد الحرام كُلَّ مَرْصَدٍ كلّ ممرّ ومجتاز
claims.claim_ar: إطناب وشرح لمصطلح «مرصد» بتفصيله وتوسيع معناه (كل ممر ومجتاز)، أي توضيح دلالي لتأكيد شمولية الحصار/التتبع.
claims.claim_en: Itnaab (amplification/explanatory expansion) of the term 'مرصد' by specifying it means 'every passage and thoroughfare', clarifying the comprehensiveness of surveillance/blockade.
claims.needs_review_reason: Confirm that the commentator's explanatory expansion is best labeled 'itnaab' (explanatory amplification) rather than simple gloss.
claims.rhetorical_effect: Clarifies and intensifies the scope of the injunction by making its practical implications explicit.

warnings: Extraction limited to provided source chunks. Several obvious rhetorical readings that involve the final clause (e.g., contrast between the harsh commands and the closing 'إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ') were not claimed because the exact quoted phrase or explicit rhetorical commentary on it was not present in the supplied chunks.

Some classifications (e.g., labeling the string of imperatives as 'takrar') are interpretive; reviewers should confirm subclass choices against broader juristic/ rhetorical definitions in the classical sources.
